newsitem.title: USA: Baltimore submits bid for 2008 or 2012 Olympics.
newsitem.headline: Baltimore submits bid for 2008 or 2012 Olympics.

text.p: Baltimore has submitted a bid to host the Olympics in either 2008 or 2012.
Maryland Stadium Authority Chairman John Moag traveled to Olympic Committee offices here to submit the $100,000 application fee.
The proposal calls for the city to host the summer Olympics either in the year 2008 or 2012. Moag said he thinks Baltimore's new football stadium will be a major advantage.
